Allahabad High Court Research Associates Recruitment 2026 : Vacancy Details
Allahabad High Court Research Associates Eligibility Details

Five year or three year Law degree obtained in the Academic Sessions – 2026, 2025 & 2024, from any Law College or University recognized by Bar Council of India. Candidates who may have appeared in LL.B. (Final Year) Examination in 2026 and may be awaiting results, may also apply. Only those Law Graduates who have scored 55% or more marks in their LL.B. examination are eligible to apply for engagement as Research Associate. Candidates must have working knowledge of Computer Applications involving Data Entry, Word Processing and similar computer operations.
